title: WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.40031v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria.   We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classical, deep, and generative watermarking methods, as well as 34 different erasing techniques, ranging from traditional distortions to more sophisticated adversarial, purification, and re-embedding attacks. translated_title: WARP：面向不可见图像水印的统一基准——鲁棒性与抗攻击保护
translated_abstract: 数字图像水印在媒体领域日益重要，因为新兴法规和行业实践要求对AI生成内容进行标记，并确保来源可追溯，以防止图像被篡改或滥用。近期不可见水印方法的进展凸显了更新现有基准测试实践的必要性，以反映当前的技术和评估标准。为此，我们提出了WARP——一个用于评估不可见水印鲁棒性的统一框架与基准。WARP纳入了32种最新的经典、深度及生成式水印方法，以及34种不同的擦除技术，涵盖从传统失真到更复杂的对抗性攻击、净化攻击和重嵌入攻击。它为评估感知质量、水印可读性和攻击抵抗力提供了标准化、可复现且易于扩展的协议。利用WARP，我们对当前主流方法进行了广泛的评估。
tldr: 提出了WARP这一统一基准，通过整合32种水印方法与34种擦除攻击技术，为不可见图像水印的鲁棒性提供标准化、可复现的评估框架。
en_tdlr: WARP introduces a unified benchmark that integrates 32 watermarking methods and 34 erasing attack techniques, providing a standardized and reproducible framework for evaluating the robustness of invisible image watermarks.
